Dataset Purpose: The Employment and Unemployment surveys of National Sample Survey (NSS) are primary sources of data on various indicators of labour force at National and State levels, used for planning, policy formulation, decision support, and further statistical exercises.

Geographic Coverage: The survey covered the whole of the Indian Union except interior villages of Nagaland situated beyond five kilometres of the bus route and villages in Andaman and Nicobar Islands which remained inaccessible throughout the year.

Population Coverage: The target population includes all households in India, with a focus on labour force characteristics at national and State levels. The survey aimed to capture information on various facets of employment and unemployment in India through Schedule 10.

Key Variables: Labour_Force_Participation_Rate: Percentage of the population participating in the labour force, Worker_Population_Ratio: Ratio of workers to the total population, Unemployment_Rate: Percentage of the labour force that is unemployed, Wages_of_Employees: Average wages earned by employees, Usual_Principal_Activity: Main activity or occupation of household members, Usual_Subsidiary_Economic_Activity: Secondary economic activity or occupation of household members, Time_Disposition_During_The_Week: Distribution of time spent on various activities during the week
Sample Size / Scope: The survey covered a large sample size of households, with an all-India household survey conducted as part of the 68th round of the NSS programme.

Important Notes: Not explicitly specified in the dataset documentation. However, it is mentioned that weights (multipliers) are given at the end of each record and can be used to generate subsample-wise estimates based on data of all subrounds taken together or a particular subround.
